transition_feasibility.missing_authority: No current in-repo workflow can publish the first validator product before the resulting-main push, hand pull_request_target from legacy 0dc to B, and preserve the complete application contract. This is a genuine new protected pre-main transaction plus scoped required-check handoff requirement, not permission to skip, downgrade, or reroute native work.

review.strict_source_merge_blocker: A source-only merge leaves current main push ci-runtime-products.yml scheduling macos-15 before the separate validator can be published.
